teaching.hint: How many choices of substring endpoints include one particular character position?

solution_outline.decisive_insight: Reorder the sum by vowel positions: position i belongs to (i+1)(n-i) substrings.
solution_outline.approach: Scan the string and add that endpoint-choice product for each vowel position.
solution_outline.state_and_invariant: The running sum is the total number of substring-position incidences whose vowel position has been processed.
solution_outline.correctness: Every vowel counted in every substring is one incidence of a substring and a contained position. For position i, independent starts 0..i and ends i..n-1 specify exactly all containing substrings. Summing these products counts every required incidence once, equal to the original total of vowel counts.
solution_outline.complexity: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space. A single contribution as well as the final sum may exceed a 32-bit integer.
solution_outline.pitfall: Do not count unique substring texts: positions and endpoint choices distinguish occurrences.

common_wrong_turns: Do not count unique substring texts: positions and endpoint choices distinguish occurrences.
source_fidelity_notes: Retained nonempty occurrence semantics and wide result; included a small derived example to clarify summing counts rather than counting substrings.
